description: This file defines the OrderHistoryScreen widget, a Flutter stateless widget that displays a list of past orders retrieved from an OrderProvider. It provides UI components for viewing order details and initiating reorder actions.

classes.name: OrderHistoryScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that displays a list of previous orders with options to view order details and reorder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the order history screen, displaying a list of past orders or a message if no orders exist.
